name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Reconnect: if a friend reinstalls the plugin or loses its keys, a new friend request from the same address renews the keys of the existing friendship (after you accept), keeping libraries, sharing settings and synced titles; each friend also has a Reconnect button. The internal key a server uses to read its own library is now replaced automatically when Jellyfin no longer knows it (this caused one-way 503 errors). Music: albums now sync with their songs. New friend requests: choose which libraries to share before sending or accepting a request; nothing is shared unless you tick it. Update both servers.
